title: Safe Decision-Making (Father-Focused)
description: This course supports fathers to make decisions that prioritise child safety, emotional stability, and respectful relationships.
learningOutcomes: Understand decision-making in the context of fatherhood.
Recognise unsafe choices that harm children or partners.
Learn strategies for safe, respectful decisions.

modules.title: Fathering and Decision Impact
modules.content: Explores how decisions shape children’s safety and wellbeing.

modules.title: Unsafe Decision Patterns
modules.content: Identifies impulsive, coercive, or harmful choices.

modules.title: Safe Decision Strategies
modules.content: Provides tools for thoughtful, respectful decision-making.
